ops.title: Restart com.yasyf.orca-serve again tonight to apply the fixed Orca db prune (Nov 15, about 22:15)?
ops.body: Yes. The owner, Nov 15 2026, about 21:53 PST: "you also need to clear out orca state again if its grown". The db is 285 MB, and the fixed prune (12 h protect window, consumed mail trimmed) takes a copy to 64 MB. Steps: prepare, wait out in-flight launches, bootout orca-serve, caffeinate -w on the serve pid, apply, bootstrap, then verify terminals and daemons.
